title: HMIPublication
description: Publication of SCADA measurements and controls on topic 'HMI.<location>.<subtopic>', tase2 extension will be present for a given output if the tase2 field has been specified in the scada_outputs.json mapping, else it will be based on scada_output_info.json. <location> is to be replaced by the name of the cyber node at which the measurement is received

time_sent.description: Simulation time at which the signal was sent

time_received.description: Simulation time at which the signal was received

tase2.description: Optional TASE.2 extension, present for TS and TM signalisation types

cause.description: Cause of transmission code (see LF Energy Cause of Transmission specification)

operatorBlocked.description: Indicates whether the signal is operator-blocked

stVal.description: Status value (TODO: one bit for single point, two bits for double point)

value.description: Measured numerical value (voltage, current, power, etc.)
